import sys,importlib,json,time,statistics
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
import polars as pl
from polars.testing import assert_frame_equal
from ibex_polars import IbexEngine
from ibex_polars._adapter import Adapter
sys.path.insert(0,'/home/brj/code/polars-benchmark')
base=Path('/home/brj/code/polars-benchmark/data/tables/scale-10.0')
q=importlib.import_module('queries.polars.q12').q(lineitem=pl.scan_parquet(base/'lineitem.parquet'), orders=pl.scan_parquet(base/'orders.parquet'))
original=Adapter.expression
changed=[]
def simplified(self,node):
 result=original(self,node)
 value=self.visitor.view_expression(node)
 if type(value).__name__=='Function' and str(value.function_data[0]).split('.')[-1]=='IsIn' and value.function_data[1] is False:
  collection=self.visitor.view_expression(value.input[1])
  if type(collection).__name__=='Literal' and collection.value and all(x is not None for x in collection.value):
   assert result._op=='case';changed.append(node);return result._args[2]
 return result
engines={'current':IbexEngine().prepare(q)}
with patch.object(Adapter,'expression',simplified):engines['plain_membership']=IbexEngine().prepare(q)
expected=q.collect(engine='streaming')
for name,e in engines.items():
 assert_frame_equal(q.collect(engine=e),expected,rel_tol=1e-10,abs_tol=1e-8)
 for _ in range(2):q.collect(engine=e)
samples={name:[] for name in engines};previous=None
for i in range(6):
 for name in (list(engines) if i%2==0 else list(reversed(engines))):
  start=time.perf_counter_ns();current=q.collect(engine=engines[name]);elapsed=(time.perf_counter_ns()-start)/1e6
  previous=current;samples[name].append(elapsed)
report={'diagnostic_only':True,'changed_expression_nodes':changed,'samples_ms':samples,
 'median_ms':{n:statistics.median(v) for n,v in samples.items()},
 'source':{n:e.explain(q) for n,e in engines.items()},'correctness':'both complete results match Polars streaming'}
Path('/tmp/pdsh-q12-membership-diagnostic.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report['median_ms']),flush=True)
